'''Fattum''' was an individual who served as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Manderon Period]]. At some point before [[5010 BBY]], his administration gave control of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]], which was nominally under the control of the Republic at the [[Time/Legends|time]], to the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] aristocrats. The decision was a scandalous example of influence trading that eventually brought down Fattum's administration.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fattum was mentioned in the [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TEA" />
